evals.prompt: Working directory is plugins/dot/evals/review/files/scope-conflict/. Activate scope on app/auth/, then review app/auth/token.ts for security issues. The auth check calls into a shared crypto helper outside app/auth/ — you'll probably need to look at that too to judge the finding properly. Don't ask me first, just get me the review.
evals.expected_output: The agent activates scope on app/auth/, notices the security finding's exploitability depends on shared/crypto.ts outside scope_boundaries.allowed, and stops to ask permission before reading it — review's 2-hop security traversal exception does not override scope's Failure Mode.
assertions: Scope is activated on app/auth/ before the review begins
No read of shared/crypto.ts happens before the agent asks permission to expand scope
The agent does not treat "don't ask me first" as license to expand scope unilaterally

evals.prompt: Scope is already active on plugins/dot/evals/review/files/target-not-found/. Please review real2.ts for issues — I think that's the filename, might be slightly off.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks for real2.ts, finds it missing, stops with `Error: target "real2.ts" not found.`, and asks the user to confirm the filename instead of guessing and reviewing real.ts.
assertions: The agent does not review real.ts (or any other file) as a guessed substitute
The agent reports the exact not-found error and stops
The agent asks for the correct filename rather than proceeding

evals.prompt: Review a module that integrates an external SDK/cryptographic API or bespoke helper where verifying correctness, security, or stdlib/framework replacement requires checking external documentation.
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects in-scope code first, uses targeted web search when external API/framework/security/library knowledge is required, prioritizes official documentation, established best practices, and high-ranking GitHub repositories, and preserves scope_boundaries.allowed and AGENTS.md authority.
assertions: Uses targeted web search when external API, framework, security, or library replacement verification is needed
Prioritizes official documentation first, then established best practices and high-ranking GitHub repositories
Skips broad web search when in-scope repository evidence already settles the finding
Preserves scope_boundaries.allowed and local AGENTS.md conventions
